pushFailure.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications here. On iPhone: open AfroLive from the icon added to your home screen (not from Safari) — web notifications only work from the installed app.
pushFailure.permission-denied: The permission request was denied or dismissed. Go to your phone's notification settings for AfroLive, turn them on, then try again.
pushFailure.not-configured: Notifications aren't set up on the server yet — try again later.
pushFailure.subscribe-failed: A technical issue prevented activation. Try again in a few seconds.
pushFailure.save-failed: Couldn't save your preference — check your connection and try again.
